neighbours.label: An opening quotation mark in mid-sentence, around a phrase being quoted or held at arm's length (described as “deeply flawed”); the same sentence with no quotation marks stays quiet
fire: Critics called the bill “a gift to the rich” in their letter.
The report describes the policy as “deeply flawed” and urges change.
The mayor's plan sounds more “business-friendly” than it is.
She said the film was "a total mess" on her blog.
The company describes itself as a "family" with shared goals.
To them, success is "being left alone" at work.
Le ministre parle d'une loi « très mauvaise » pour le pays.
He calls this "the new normal" in every interview.
